dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: You don't know of me? Or rather, you don't recognize me? Oh, wonderful. Raimondo and Choiseul's plan to erase me from the Institute has gone swimmingly. How happy I am for them.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Pleased to make your acquaintance, Honorary Senior Researcher. I am Bossuet, and I once worked at the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: I believe you might have found many a fruit of my academic labor in the Institute, and met some of my mentees to boot. Your fame has reached me here, thanks to the trusty Steambird.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, I've resigned from my post as a researcher, and I'm here in quiet retirement. Not taking mentorships at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Bossuet
dialogues.text: So if that's what you were looking for, you're going to be disappointed, I fear.
